inventory_applicability: Guest applicability is explicitly false for screenshot capture/gallery; T01-T08 are member/admin cases and are not run here.
prior_evidence: contained-navigation-006 recorded guest navigation without Screenshots, but predates the dedicated EXT-F-1009 guest case and does not exercise its stale-selection subcase.
runner_behavior: Uses the receipt-verified owned native-profile harness and trusted tab navigation. It checks trigger absence and protected-content absence after public navigation. It does not capture, read, copy, or delete screenshots or call backend services.

execution: Not run in preparation lane; awaiting root source peer and resource admission.
evidence_safety: Counts and booleans only; any failure screenshot is uniquely named, exclusive-created, mode 0600, and stored under harness-owned private artifacts.
